scope: Current applicability questions; accepted current-source economics and engineering evidence are retained separately.
scan_rule: Follow research/registry.json families[].research_questions and select status=pending_validation. Read current_evidence separately; a pending hypothesis does not invalidate an accepted bounded result.

questions.question: Does conditional touch calibration transfer across volatility, distance, side and decision clocks?
questions.question_zh: 条件触达概率能否跨波动率、距离、方向和决策时钟迁移？
gaps: A static train-only P3 component is implemented in the new chain; this does not validate old conditional surfaces or their absolute fill-probability interpretation.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Fit on declared training support; compare static and conditional calibration on common visible-state opportunities, censor gaps and evaluate actual policy-clock transport.

questions.question: Can a reach-time distribution improve an executable quote decision?
questions.question_zh: 触达时间分布能否改善可执行的报价决策？
gaps: Touch is not fill; old hazard ranking or support thresholds are not current action evidence.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Separate first-touch time, order activation, queue depletion and terminal account value; evaluate prediction before a separately bound action comparison.

questions.question: Does compressing conditional touch probabilities into a symmetric scalar quote adapter improve net economic value on the current source and frozen B0, or mainly increase turnover and adverse inventory exposure?
questions.question_zh: 条件触达概率经双侧标量映射后，能否在当前数据和冻结B0上改善净价值，还是主要增加成交和不利库存暴露？
questions.historical_observation: An August scalar-adapter report described tighter quotes, more fills and worse terminal MTM. This describes that old experiment only, not an accepted current-source finding.
gaps: Old source and B0 are not current bindings.
Previously viewed mixed evaluation dates and reused conditional models limit interpretation.
Touch-to-fill/intensity mapping and symmetric aggregation are modeling assumptions; a negative result does not itself prove a code defect.
questions.next_validation: Complete the already authorized same-family redo: freeze current inputs/B0/training support, audit units and causal visibility, then compare full matched accounts including total and unit net returns, fills and inventory. No tuning on consumed Final.

current_evidence.boundary: The new-source chain uses train-only static P3 calibration. It does not complete conditional touch, scalar-adapter or reach-time economic validation. The current scalar-adapter redo remains a separate question, not a result inferred from other trained models.
